title: Add team policy and encrypted sync only after local core
note: Per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md, this task is implemented and its tests are written in this change, but manifest commands are not executed and status is not set to pass here. The orchestrator commits, runs the Wave 4 phase of the Book 3 final phased gate, and finalizes this evidence.

startingPoint.note: A prior commit already on this branch (17af5feb, 'feat(team): add confined encrypted policy sync contract') had laid a minimal content-free contract: TeamPolicySyncV1/EncryptedReplicationEnvelopeV1/TeamPolicyReceiptV1 in membrane-protocol, and a fail-closed admit_team_policy in membrane-runtime that trusts a caller-supplied TeamPolicyTrustVerifier for encryption/authorization/user-origin-learning-scope and rejects non-increasing generations. That commit explicitly deferred 'real crypto, key lifecycle, transport, persistence, and export' as integration gates, and touched no crypt-store path. This task closes those specific gaps: strict local opt-in (off by default), durable fail-closed local persistence, key-rotation-aware admission, and local audit export -- without modifying the existing contract's behavior.

protocol.summary: Adds TeamSyncOptInV1: the local, content-free, off-by-default opt-in record (tenant_id, team_id, key_id, enabled, enabled_at). TeamSyncOptInV1::disabled() is the only well-formed value with enabled=false (every field empty); has_valid_bounds() requires every identifier when enabled=true and forbids any leftover identifier when enabled=false. Nothing in TeamPolicySyncV1 (the wire type) can construct or mutate this type -- there is no conversion, Default impl, or wire-deserialization path that produces an enabled TeamSyncOptInV1; only an explicit Rust construction by a local caller can.

runtime.summary: Adds admit_team_policy_with_opt_in, wrapping the existing admit_team_policy with three fail-closed gates checked before trusted verification ever runs: (1) SyncNotOptedIn when opt_in.enabled is false or opt_in fails has_valid_bounds(); (2) TenantOrTeamMismatch when the policy's tenant/team differs from the opted-in tenant/team; (3) KeyMismatch when the envelope's key_id differs from the opted-in key_id (a key rotated on the sending side is only ever followed after an explicit local re-opt-in, never silently). Only after all three pass does it delegate, unmodified, to admit_team_policy -- so bounds validation, replay-by-generation, trusted encryption/authorization, and user-origin-learning-scope preservation keep exactly their existing behavior; opting in only narrows what can reach them.

cryptStore.summary: New store-side module (mirrors the existing maintenance_exec.rs pattern: the runtime layer decides *whether* something is trustworthy, crypt-store executes/persists what only durable local storage can verify). Adds three new SQLite tables created lazily via idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (same pattern as temporal.rs), entirely independent of memdb.rs's versioned migration chain so LATEST_SCHEMA_VERSION and every existing migration/backout function are untouched: membrane_team_sync_opt_in (single row; its mere existence is the opt-in signal), membrane_team_sync_state (per tenant/team last-admitted generation + key/envelope id, for replay defense that survives a restart), and membrane_team_sync_audit_log (append-only, content-free decision ledger). Public API: enable_team_sync_opt_in / disable_team_sync_opt_in / team_sync_opt_in_status (explicit local opt-in/out; nothing else can touch this table); commit_team_policy_admission(policy, runtime_admitted, runtime_reason) -- the fail-closed local gate, refusing before opening any transaction or writing anything when there is no opt-in record, a tenant/team mismatch, or a key mismatch, then (once past those) re-deriving generation monotonicity itself inside one IMMEDIATE transaction (crash-safe, same transaction-then-commit-only-on-success shape as execute_bounded_maintenance) and always appending one audit row, advancing state only when admitted; team_sync_audit_log -- read-only, tenant/team-scoped, newest-first local audit export. No column in this schema can hold a private key, a symmetric key, or decrypted policy content -- only opaque ids and the sha256: ciphertext digest already present on the wire envelope. No SQL statement in this module names memories, memory_quarantine, context_feedback, or membrane_temporal_fact -- it cannot weaken local root confinement or user-origin learning boundaries because it has no code path into those tables at all.

docs.summary: Documents the opt-in gate and local persistence/audit-export layers added by this task alongside the existing contract description.

implementation.newDependency: none. crypt-store already depended on membrane-protocol (engine/crates/crypt-store/Cargo.toml, pre-existing); no Cargo.toml in this task's diff changes.
